headline: Hampshire Gardener Grows World's Heaviest Pumpkin at 2,856 Pounds
meta_description: Ian Paton from Hampshire has grown the heaviest pumpkin ever recorded, weighing 2,856.8 lbs—heavier than a white rhino.
summary_short: A 65-year-old gardener in Hampshire has achieved an extraordinary feat: growing the heaviest pumpkin ever recorded at 2,856.8 pounds, surpassing all previous records.
body:
At a recent British competition, volunteers at Wargrave Nursery carefully hoisted an extraordinary pumpkin onto the scale and watched as the needle settled on a historic number: 2,856.8 pounds. The massive specimen, grown by 65-year-old Ian Paton from Lymington in Hampshire, is now officially the heaviest pumpkin ever cultivated by a human—heavier than a white rhino, heavier than a Volkswagen Beetle, and by a decisive margin, the undisputed champion of all recorded pumpkins. A certified judge declared it "the most massive specimen ever to have existed" in the entire 100-million-year history of fruiting plants on Earth.

Paton achieved this remarkable milestone during his first solo attempt at giant pumpkin growing, after spending five decades perfecting the craft alongside his brother Stuart. Throughout the growing season, he dedicated six hours daily to caring for the gourd, which demanded an extraordinary 130 gallons of water per day—a testament to both the plant's ambition and the grower's commitment. He named his creation Bagheera, after the black panther from Rudyard Kipling's *The Jungle Book*, a fitting moniker for such a magnificent beast.

What makes Paton's achievement even more remarkable is the context: the UK endured an unprecedented heatwave during the summer months when Bagheera was developing. Despite these harsh conditions, the pumpkin not only survived but thrived, outweighing last year's competitor by 45 pounds. While Bagheera's circumference didn't break the fattest-pumpkin record—an honor still held by Ian and Stuart's 2025 entry—its sheer weight stands unmatched. When its journey concludes, Bagheera will be repurposed as nourishment for cattle, ensuring this remarkable plant contributes even in its final chapter.
quick_facts: Ian Paton grew the world's heaviest pumpkin at 2,856.8 lbs
The pumpkin required 130 gallons of water daily during growing season
Paton spent 6 hours each day tending the record-breaking gourd
Bagheera weighed more than a white rhino or Volkswagen Beetle
Grown in Hampshire, England during unprecedented summer heatwave
